09 FOR ESTATE AGENTS & DEVELOPERS

Studio video for property teams.

Think about the first phone call after a listing goes up. If three buyers have asked the same question, that’s a good first video. Record the answer at the desk, or bring a colleague for a conversation about the neighbourhood.

Plan a property shoot ↗Session rates ↗

01 SESSION NOTES

One buyer question per clip.

01

Put the agent on camera

Choose a question you can answer from first-hand experience. A relocation guide, a viewing checklist and a project introduction each work better as a separate piece.

02

Bring visuals you can use

Send the floor plans, approved renders or neighbourhood photos you want on screen. We can plan the presenter’s lines around those visuals. The session takes place in the studio.

03

Make a set your team can return to

Use an agreed logo, camera angle and lighting look across the series. Decide before recording which answers will run on your website and which need vertical framing for social.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

Can several agents record in one visit?

Yes. Send the number of speakers, a running order and each person’s topics. We’ll allow for changeovers and quote the block.

Does a session include a property walkthrough?

The session covers recording at UE Studios. If you already have property footage, share the brief so we can price cutting it into your studio interview.

SESSION PLANNER

Put your session on paper.

Choose a starting point and save a brief. Pilot prices and dates are confirmed separately.
